title: Approve numerical M1 acceptance limits
summary: James accepted exact preservation of points, validity flags and pose on reload; every expected noise-free floor/wall intersection within 1 mm; and at least 95% of expected noisy intersections returned within 7 cm, with missing hits counting against the total. False returns are reported separately. Preserve existing noise parameters and freeze the scene/seed before running. These are approved simulation-test criteria, not a completed capability or hardware accuracy claim.
next: Define the fixed scene and reproducibility settings from the lead’s existing floor/wall sensor check before assignment and implementation.
